_comment: The dark-device ladder as DATA (#777). States are DEVICE knowledge states; each ladder rung is a transition whose probe verdict picks the edge: on_positive moves to the state the evidence establishes; on_negative is a SELF-EDGE (a negative adds no device knowledge — the run falls through to the next rung). The one exception is the layer-0 control gate, whose negative aborts (methodology-unverified). Kept in lockstep with bench_discover.build_ladder() by tests/test_strategy_states.py — a rung without a transition (or vice versa) is a bug. listen verdicts (bootlisten.py next_action ids) seed discover's initial state via entry_hints.

states.description: No frames ever, including the bootloader phase, across a fresh power cycle (DARK-DEVICE-PLAYBOOK: the only genuine serial-gated class)
Layer-0 positive control failed — every negative below would be meaningless (AGENTS rule 11); ABORT
EUI-64 link-local answers, or all-nodes/NDP evidence — kernel up; v6 doors open (dbclient, zone-scoped)
Static v4 found by host-subnet sweep or inventory archaeology
SSH banner observed on any discovered address (v4 or v6)
LFP probe: SYN to a closed port elicits an RST with iTTL/IPID — IP stack answers with no doors open
Credential ladder reached — PRINTED ONLY, never auto-executed (human gate by design)

transitions.probe: ping the control host off the probe iface
transitions.comment: a gate, not a device move: positive validates methodology (stay at dark, negatives below become trustworthy)

transitions.probe: ip neigh show (NDP cache for the derived link-local)
ARP sweep of host-own subnets + inventory archaeology
SSH banner on :22 across discovered addresses
SYN to a closed port; watch RST iTTL/IPID

entry_hints._comment: bootlisten next_action ids → the state discover should START from (listen seeds discover instead of re-probing from dark)
